marketImplications.side: Do not treat Cardinals as a plain full-game ML. Price the starter window, bridge, and conversion risk separately.
marketImplications.first5: First-five may be cleaner than full game if the starter-window edge is on the pick and the late edge flips.
marketImplications.total: No forced total edge. Wait for a line move or a clearer first-five total.
